name: Amulet of Divine Retribution

attunement.text: by a creature with at least 1 level in Cleric

entries: This silver amulet, engraved with glowing holy runes, hums faintly with divine power. When a cleric channels their faith, the amulet lashes out at their foes, turning holy resolve into swift judgment.

Divine Wrath (1/day). As an action, target one hostile creature you can see within 60 feet. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, it becomes vulnerable to radiant and fire damage for 1 minute. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Divine Protection (1/day). As an action, you radiate a protective aura for up to 1 minute while concentrating. At the start of each of your turns, allies within 30 feet regain 1d10 hit points.
